title: Independent arborescences on convex sets in acyclic digraphs
statement: Let D=(V,A) be an acyclic digraph, let r_1,...,r_k be designated roots, and let U_1,...,U_k be convex vertex sets with r_i in U_i. If, for every v, the paths r_i-to-v for all i with v in U_i can be chosen pairwise openly node-disjoint, then there are independent r_i-arborescences F_i with V(F_i)=U_i.

counterexample.description: An acyclic digraph with three distinct roots and three convex sets having a genuine three-way overlap, where the required openly node-disjoint paths exist locally at every vertex but no independent family of three prescribed-set arborescences exists.
